nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_2
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
The Director is a policy/selector layer; metrics is the simulation layer. 

Director: just pass Now = GetGameTimeInSeconds into Director_Evaluate(Now)

Everything Director does is based on absolute-time comparisons:

    Now - LastStaggerTime >= StaggerCooldown

    Now - LastDefenseTime >= DefenseCooldown

    Now - LastDirectorActionTime >= MinSecondsBetweenDirectorActions

Those comparisons do not require DeltaTime accumulation; they are already robust to timer jitter.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_22
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Allowed transitions : 

Combat to Defense
Combat to Vulnerable
Combat to Stagger

Defense to Combat
Defense to Stagger

Vulnerable to Combat
Vulnerable to Stagger

Stagger to TransitionPhase2
Combat to TransitionPhase2
Vulnerable to TransitionPhase2

Forbidden transitions :

Stagger to Defense      X
Stagger to Vulnerable   X
Any to Stagger to Anything else before completion   X

Required resolution : 

Stagger to Combat (aggresive combat preferably)

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_23
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Where to enforce “Defense to Combat” and “Vulnerable to Combat”

In the states Exit(Completed), not in the Director.

   DefenseResetState Exit(Completed): SetMode(Combat) 

   VulnerableState Exit(Completed): SetMode(Combat)

   StaggerState Exit(Completed): SetMode(Combat) and unlock

That keeps the Director as a chooser, not a babysitter.
